versos.hebraico: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר׃

controles.web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
controles.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
controles.livre: Aquele que ama a correção ama o conhecimento; mas aquele que odeia a repreensão é um bruto.

versos.hebraico: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃

controles.web: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked devices.
controles.kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
controles.livre: O homem de bem ganha o favor do SENHOR; mas ao homem de pensamentos perversos, ele o condenará.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃

controles.web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
controles.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
controles.livre: O homem não prevalecerá pela perversidade; mas a raiz dos justos não será removida.

versos.hebraico: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה׃

controles.web: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
controles.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
controles.livre: A mulher virtuosa é a coroa de seu marido; mas a causadora de vergonha é como uma podridão em seus ossos.

versos.hebraico: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
controles.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
controles.livre: Os pensamentos dos justos são de bom juízo; mas os conselhos dos perversos são enganosos.

versos.hebraico: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב־דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃

controles.web: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
controles.kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
controles.livre: As palavras dos perversos são para espreitar o derramamento de sangue de inocentes ; mas a boca dos corretos os livrará.

versos.hebraico: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד׃

controles.web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
controles.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
controles.livre: Os perversos serão transtornados, e não existirão mais ; porém a casa dos justos permanecerá.

versos.hebraico: לְֽפִי־שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז׃

controles.web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
controles.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
controles.livre: Cada um será elogiado conforme seu entendimento; mas o perverso de coração será desprezado.

versos.hebraico: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר־לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: Better is he who is lightly esteemed, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
controles.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
controles.livre: Melhor é o que estima pouco a si mesmo mas tem quem o sirva, do que aquele que elogia e si mesmo, mas nem sequer tem pão.

versos.hebraico: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי׃

controles.web: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
controles.kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
controles.livre: O justo dá atenção à vida de seus animais; mas até as misericórdias dos perversos são cruéis.

versos.hebraico: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

controles.web: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
controles.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
controles.livre: Aquele que lavra sua terra se saciará de pão; mas o que segue coisas inúteis tem falta de juízo.

versos.hebraico: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

controles.web: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
controles.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
controles.livre: O perverso deseja armadilhas malignas; porém a raiz dos justos produzirá seu fruto .

versos.hebraico: בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק׃

controles.web: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
controles.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
controles.livre: O perverso é capturado pela transgressão de seus lábios, mas o justo sairá da angústia.

versos.hebraico: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי־אָ֝דָ֗ם ישוב לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
controles.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
controles.livre: Cada um se sacia do bem pelo fruto de sua própria boca; e a recompensa das mãos do homem lhe será entregue de volta.

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם׃

controles.web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
controles.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
controles.livre: O caminho do tolo é correto aos seus próprios olhos; mas aquele que ouve o bom conselho é sábio.

versos.hebraico: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם׃

controles.web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
controles.kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
controles.livre: A ira do tolo é conhecida no mesmo dia, mas o prudente ignora o insulto.

versos.hebraico: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
controles.kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
controles.livre: Aquele que fala a verdade conta a justiça; porém a testemunha falsa conta o engano.

versos.hebraico: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃

controles.web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
controles.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
controles.livre: Há alguns que falam palavras como que golpes de espada; porém a língua do sábios é como um remédio.

versos.hebraico: שְֽׂפַת־אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד־אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
controles.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
controles.livre: O lábio da verdade ficará para sempre, mas a língua da falsidade dura por apenas um momento.

versos.hebraico: מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה׃

controles.web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
controles.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
controles.livre: Há engano no coração dos que tramam o mal; mas os que aconselham a paz têm alegria.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כָּל־אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע׃

controles.web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
controles.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
controles.livre: Nenhuma adversidade sobrevirá ao justos; mas os perversos se encherão de mal.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
controles.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.
controles.livre: Os lábios mentirosos são abomináveis ao SENHOR, mas dos que falam a verdade são seu prazer.

versos.hebraico: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

controles.web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
controles.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
controles.livre: O homem prudente é discreto em conhecimento; mas o coração dos tolos proclama a loucura.

versos.hebraico: יַד־חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס׃

controles.web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
controles.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
controles.livre: A mão dos que trabalham com empenho dominará, e os preguiçosos se tornarão escravos.

versos.hebraico: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
controles.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
controles.livre: A ansiedade no coração do homem o abate; mas uma boa palavra o alegra.

versos.hebraico: יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם׃

controles.web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
controles.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
controles.livre: O justo age cuidadosamente para com seu próximo, mas o caminho dos perversos os faz errar.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ׃

controles.web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
controles.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
controles.livre: O preguiçoso não assa aquilo que caçou, mas a riqueza de quem trabalha com empenho lhe é preciosa.

versos.hebraico: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל־מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
controles.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
controles.livre: Na vereda da justiça está a vida; e no caminho de seu percurso não há morte.
